_comment: X search queries mapped to the article each one should point at. Edit freely. min_faves is a floor inside X's own search; --min filters again on our combined score.

queries.label: water-filters
queries.query: ("water filter" OR "water filtration" OR "reverse osmosis") (microplastics OR PFAS OR "forever chemicals") min_faves:15 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: bottled-water
queries.query: ("bottled water" OR "plastic bottle") (microplastics OR nanoplastics) min_faves:20 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: cookware-pfas
queries.query: (cookware OR nonstick OR "non-stick" OR teflon OR "ceramic pan") (PFAS OR "forever chemicals" OR toxic) min_faves:25 -filter:replies -filter:retweets lang:en

queries.label: sunscreen
